definitions.explanation: The designated place where passengers board trains, buses, or taxis.

examples.japanese: ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The taxi stand is in front of the station.

examples.japanese: 5⟦{番|ばん}→〜番：09873_ban⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ます→出る：00513_deru⟧。

notes:
Combines {乗|の}る (to ride) + {場|ば} (place). A general term for any boarding area or platform for transportation.

COMMON TYPES:
- バス{乗|の}り{場|ば}: bus boarding area/bus stop
- タクシー{乗|の}り{場|ば}: taxi stand
- {電車|でんしゃ}{乗|の}り{場|ば}: train platform
- {船|ふね}{乗|の}り{場|ば}: boat/ferry boarding area
- {遊園地|ゆうえんち}の{乗|の}り{場|ば}: amusement park ride boarding area

NUMBERED PLATFORMS:
At train stations, platforms are numbered: 1{番|ばん}{乗|の}り{場|ば}, 2{番|ばん}{乗|の}り{場|ば}, etc. Station announcements use this format.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ホーム (platform — specifically for trains, from English "platform")
- {停留所|ていりゅうじょ}: bus stop (official/formal term)
- バス{停|てい}: bus stop (casual)

The 〜{場|ば} suffix appears in many location words: {売|う}り{場|ば} (sales floor), {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} (parking lot), {遊|あそ}び{場|ば} (playground).
